name: memory-safety-fuzz
description: The memory_safety_fuzz axis adapter of the gauntlet, Tools/gauntlet/harness/memory-safety-fuzz.mjs, and its Jet twin, the MemorySafetyFuzz module of the jet_gauntlet_kit package (Tools/gauntlet/kit/Source/MemorySafetyFuzz.jet), #5072 c8, each run by a driver that runs the adapter on one axis in the case directory (runner files copied from it, a tool available when a file of its name is there, commands run as declared) and prints the report: a runner that compiles and prints the oracle line (complete, ready to publish); runners that print a wrong answer, report an AddressSanitizer fault (twice, at other addresses and lines, deduplicated into one receipt), crash with an address and a line number in their stderr, fail to compile, warn in their compile output, modify the shared input and exit non-zero with no output (findings, each a Tower receipt); runners with a missing tool, a tool whose probe fails and a file that cannot be staged beside one that completes (incomplete, blocked); and the error of a corpus too small for its records and of an axis with no runners.
